title: NSL Operations Platform
summary: Order entry, credit and daily cash for a water and building materials supplier taking up to 2,000 orders a day.
problem: NSL sells RO and borewell water by the tanker load plus cement, M-sand, bricks and its own hollow blocks. Cash orders went into a notebook; credit went into offline desktop software that lost a full Saturday of entries (₹4,00,000) when its LAN sync broke, twice. In peak season orders arrive 3–5 a minute, and staff did not trust any screen to keep up with a pen.
solution: A cloud platform designed around one rule: order entry must be provably faster than the notebook. One config-driven order screen serves the water, materials and hollow-block units. Behind it sit a live queue, credit customers, suppliers, production, salaries and daily reconciliation, and the owner follows it all from a phone app.

features.title: Faster than a notebook
features.description: Phone lookup, quantity presets and a keyboard-only flow; the target is a water order in under 5 seconds.

features.title: One engine, many units
features.description: Water, materials and hollow blocks run from the same screen through unit configuration, not new code.

features.title: Live order queue
features.description: The notebook's running list, on screen, for every counter.

features.title: Daily reconciliation
features.description: Counter cash, digital payments and expenses close to the rupee every evening.

features.title: Credit customers
features.description: Balances in two seconds and statements sent on WhatsApp.

features.title: Suppliers, production and salary
features.description: Bulk purchases, hollow-block production and driver salaries in one place.

features.title: Owner app
features.description: Installable dashboard on the owner's phone with all units or one at a time.
